plan.problem: Global epsilon 1e-8 reduced early rotation drift but harmed pipes mean PSNR. Isolate rotation parameters while retaining the original epsilon for position, scale, opacity and color.
plan.change: Optional per-parameter Adam epsilon stored with optimizer state; rotation gets 1e-8, every other group stays 1e-15. Preserve the override across steps and refinement state transformations.
plan.acceptance: Verify rotation state persistence and first-update equation; compare same-camera quality on pipes and office before considering adoption. No full-model determinism claim.

raw_runs.measurement: adapter training, evaluation and export; excludes SfM and input copy

timing_scope: Adapter training/evaluation/export with the same instrumented local binary; excludes source compilation, SfM and input copy. OS/driver caches not flushed. Image trace is enabled equally in both variants.
quality_scope: Frozen historical shared-camera scenes; every eighth image held out from training but used in SfM. Compare RGB PSNR and Gaussian-window SSIM at long edge 512. Two repeats are exploratory.

gradient_analysis.scope: First-update raw f32 gradient and raw quaternion tensors, observed with identical synchronous readbacks in both modes. First Adam equation checked at lr_rotation=0.001.

observation_scope: Same first-step gradient/raw quaternion readbacks and normalized PLY snapshots at steps 0/1/10/100 in both variants; observation forces GPU synchronization and may alter scheduling. Timings include this overhead.

validation.gpu_parameter_state_test: epsilon_override_stays_with_parameter_state passed; checks repeated updates, unmodified parameter fallback, record conversion and device transfer

browser.observations: Fine pipes, cables and edges remain blurred or stretched; missing coverage and floating fragments persist during roaming.

decision: Reject rotation-only epsilon 1e-8 as default: early rotation drift is smaller but both scenes lose mean PSNR and SSIM. Keep the optional experiment and state test, preserve the installed official engine.
